summary: Frontend-only landing page tested at desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). All 14 sections render, sticky header stays fixed, every CTA scrolls to the intended target (#pricing / #examples / #risk-disclaimer), pricing shows $550 and $995 with Best Value badge, sonner toast 'Checkout placeholder' fires for both pricing CTAs, FAQ accordion expands/collapses for triggers 1-8, mobile hamburger Sheet opens with all nav links + CTA, sticky-mobile-cta appears after scroll past 600px and scrolls to pricing. No JS errors on page load; testimonial images load with valid naturalWidth/Height; WhatsApp preview + market dashboard cards render. Two non-blocking a11y/UX issues found.

issues: A11y warning in console: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users.' Add a visually-hidden SheetTitle inside SheetContent in Header.jsx to satisfy Radix a11y requirements and remove the console warning.

Visibility state can remain 'true' if user programmatically jumps back to top during/after a smooth scroll (scroll event ordering). Minor; doesn't affect normal user scrolling. Optional fix: also gate render via current scrollY in render or trigger an initial onScroll() in useEffect.

action_items: Add a hidden SheetTitle (e.g. <SheetTitle className='sr-only'>Menu</SheetTitle>) inside Header.jsx SheetContent to remove the Radix a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: scrollTo helper uses scrollIntoView('start') and all target sections use scroll-mt-20 to clear the 64px sticky header — clean.
Pricing toast uses sonner correctly; Toaster is mounted in LandingPage with position='top-center' richColors.
Header.jsx Sheet is missing a SheetTitle which violates Radix Dialog accessibility contract and emits a console error in production builds too.
No backend coupling; REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is unused by the landing page as expected — frontend-only spec satisfied.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All data-testid selectors used in spec verified working. Smooth-scroll targets land at y≈80 (header offset) which matches scroll-mt-20. Pricing CTAs use sonner toasts. Sticky mobile CTA threshold confirmed at scrollY>600. Console produces only a Radix a11y warning about missing DialogTitle in the mobile Sheet — fix by adding a visually-hidden SheetTitle.
rca of the issue: Radix UI Dialog (used by shadcn Sheet) requires a DialogTitle child for screen-reader announcements. The mobile-menu Sheet in Header.jsx omits it, producing a console warning every time the menu opens. Fix: import SheetTitle from '@/components/ui/sheet' and render '<SheetTitle className="sr-only">Menu</SheetTitle>' inside SheetContent.
